name: CartNexa Instant Add to Cart for WooCommerce
author: iiTechnology

sections.description:
CartNexa Instant Add to Cart for WooCommerce helps you add powerful, customizable Add to Cart buttons anywhere on your website using a simple shortcode.

Boost your WooCommerce conversions with instant add to cart, Buy Now buttons, and direct checkout functionality.

Whether you are creating landing pages, sales funnels, or product promotions, CartNexa gives you full control over how customers interact with your products.

Key Features

✓ Add to Cart button anywhere using shortcode
✓ Buy Now button with direct checkout
✓ AJAX add to cart (no page reload)
✓ Fully customizable button design
✓ Live preview button editor
✓ Works with Elementor, Gutenberg, and all themes
✓ Lightweight and fast performance
✓ No impact on default WooCommerce functionality

Why Use CartNexa?

Most WooCommerce stores lose conversions due to unnecessary steps.

CartNexa reduces friction by allowing users to:
– Add products instantly
– Skip cart page
– Go directly to checkout
– Purchase faster

Use Cases

✓ Landing pages
✓ Sales funnels
✓ Blog product promotion
✓ One-page checkout
✓ Affiliate-style product pages

How It Works

  1. Install and activate plugin
  2. Copy shortcode from product page
  3. Paste anywhere on your website
  4. Customers can instantly add to cart or buy

Shortcode Example

[cartnexa_add_to_cart id=”123″]

Compatibility

✓ WooCommerce
✓ Elementor
✓ Gutenberg
✓ All WordPress themes

Performance Optimized

Scripts load only when shortcode is used, ensuring fast website speed.

Disclaimer

This plugin is not affiliated with or endorsed by WooCommerce.
sections.installation:
1. Upload plugin to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin
  3. Go to WooCommerce → CartNexa Settings
  4. Use shortcode on any page
sections.faq:
Can I use this with Elementor?

Yes, the shortcode works perfectly with Elementor and all page builders.

Does this plugin support Buy Now button?

Yes, you can enable direct checkout (Buy Now) from settings.

Will this slow down my site?

No, the plugin loads scripts only when needed.

Can I customize button design?

Yes, you can fully customize colors, size, padding, and hover styles.

Does it affect WooCommerce default behavior?

No, the plugin works only via shortcode and does not override WooCommerce core functionality.
